dct_description_sm: The data is being gathered to document Inuit knowledge of the land and land use from the Quebec-Labrador border to the Labrador Sea south of Nain, in the general area of the Voisey's Bay mine development (Anaktalak Bay). The project is being done as part of the Inuit Knowledge and Geospatial Ontology project led by C Furgal (Trent U) and T Sheldon (Nunatsiavut Government) to support decision-making related to land use and development in the region and to document this knowledge for transmission to younger generations in the coastal communities.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Inuit Knowledge
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Landuse
dct_title_s: Inuit land use and knowledge in Nunatsiavut: the Nain and Voisey's Bay area
